tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Which tokens are listed on Kyte and can have options written on them, with whether puts are enabled, the exposure cap and the minimum strike per token. Read-only.

tools.name: find_offers
tools.description: Open option offers you can buy right now, filterable by token and kind (call or put), soonest expiry first. Each row has strike per token, premium, amount, expiry and a link. Read-only.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: One offer or position in full by its id: kind, token, amount, strike, premium, expiry, seller, holder, status, fees and the transaction that created it. Read-only.

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: What an address holds (options it can exercise), is selling (its open and filled offers) and its recent history. Pass the connected wallet address. Read-only.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Live price in ETH per token for every listed token with a feed, the 1 hour change, the source (Uniswap v4 swaps, a DEX price or a Robinhood quote), for FOBO launchpad tokens the floor price the hook guarantees, and, for stock tokens, the session state (open, held over the weekend, halted, paused, st

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: Recent OHLC candles for a token, in ETH per token. Use for "how has X moved today". Read-only.

tools.name: get_staking
tools.description: Staking state: total $KYTE staked, the current epoch and when it ends, last epoch rewards, and for a given address its active and pending stake and claimable WETH. Read-only.

tools.name: get_protocol_stats
tools.description: Protocol totals: volume, fees, open interest, $KYTE burned, $KYTE staked, number of stakers, active and total offers. Read-only.

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Every fee split (per epoch, with the WETH to stakers, buyback and operations) and every $KYTE buyback burn, each with its transaction hash. Read-only.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Recent protocol events: listings, fills, exercises, expiries, cancellations, fee splits, burns and staking, newest first, each with a transaction hash. Read-only.

tools.name: explain_offer
tools.description: Plain-language economics of one offer for both sides: what the buyer pays and gets, breakeven per token, max loss and max payoff, what the seller receives after fees, exercise fee, time left. Computed from get_offer and get_prices. Read-only.

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.description: Rank the open offers on one token: premium per token, premium as a share of strike, strike versus spot, time to expiry. Returns a sorted table with a short reason per row. Information only. Read-only.

tools.name: list_graduated
tools.description: Launchpad tokens on Robinhood Chain. launchpad=pons (default): graduated (locked liquidity crossed 4.2 ETH), near graduation, recent, or the ones listed on Kyte. launchpad=fobo: tokens from fobo.fun, whose floor only rises; status eligible = the floor backs 4.2 ETH after 24 h (Kyte lists these), nea

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: The user's Autopilot rules and the triggers waiting for them (prepared actions to review and sign). Needs the wallet address.

tools.name: get_rewards
tools.description: USDG trading rewards: the pool this 24 h epoch, the scoring rules (points per ETH of fee paid, 1.5x for cash-secured puts on stock tokens, 0.2x for open interest carried through an epoch end), and for a given address its points and estimated USDG this epoch, the epochs it can claim now and what it h

tools.name: prepare_buy
tools.description: Prepare buying an open offer: returns a preview of what the buyer pays and gets and a kyte.sh link that opens the buy dialog for that offer. Does not send anything; the user signs in their wallet. Prepares only; never sends.

tools.name: prepare_covered_call
tools.description: Prepare a covered call: validates token, amount, strike per token (ETH), premium (ETH) and expiry against the protocol rules, then returns a preview and a kyte.sh Sell link with the form pre-filled. The seller must hold the tokens. Does not send anything. Prepares only; never sends.

tools.name: prepare_cash_secured_put
tools.description: Prepare a cash-secured put (only on tokens with puts enabled): validates the inputs and returns a preview and a pre-filled kyte.sh Sell link. The seller locks the strike in WETH. Does not send anything. Prepares only; never sends.

tools.name: prepare_exercise
tools.description: Prepare exercising a held option: checks it is filled and not expired, previews what the holder pays and receives including the exercise fee, and returns the kyte.sh Positions link. Does not send anything. Prepares only; never sends.

tools.name: prepare_stake
tools.description: Prepare staking or unstaking $KYTE, or claiming WETH rewards: returns a preview and a pre-filled kyte.sh Stake link. Does not send anything. Prepares only; never sends.

tools.name: design_strategy
tools.description: Turn a plain-language strategy into an Autopilot rule (sell covered calls or puts on a schedule, flag cheap calls or puts to buy, exercise in-the-money options, cancel stale offers). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_prices, list_strategies · Private data: list_tokens, find_offers, get_offer, get_positions, get_prices, get_chart, explain_offer, compare_offers, list_graduated, list_strategies, get_rewards, prepare_buy, prepare_covered_call, prepare_cash_secured_put · Public sink: compare_offers, prepare_buy, prepare_covered_call, prepare_cash_secured_put, prepare_exercise, prepare_stake.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_prices, list_strategies · Private data: list_tokens, find_offers, get_offer, get_positions, get_prices, get_chart, explain_offer, compare_offers, list_graduated, list_strategies, get_rewards, prepare_buy, prepare_covered_call, prepare_cash_secured_put · Public sink: compare_offers, prepare_buy, prepare_covered_call, prepare_cash_secured_put, prepare_exercise, prepare_stake

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
